map.依据 GB 2761：比较检测值与对应食品类别限量（如花生及其制品黄曲霉毒素 B: Per GB 2761: compare the measured value with the limit for the matching food category (for example, the aflatoxin B₁ limit for peanuts and their products is 20 μg/kg); anything not above the limit passes.
map.某批次花生酱检出黄曲霉毒素 B₁ = 5.0 μg/kg，限量 20 μg/kg: A batch of peanut butter tests at aflatoxin B₁ = 5.0 μg/kg against a limit of 20 μg/kg: 5.0 < 20, so it passes; at 25 it exceeds the limit and the batch must be withdrawn and traced.
map.是。谷物、豆类、坚果及乳制品限量各异，且部分产品（如婴幼儿食品）更严，须按品类查: Yes. Limits differ across cereals, legumes, nuts and dairy, and some products such as infant food are stricter, so check GB 2761 by category.
map.否，须与对应限量比较；但毒素具累积毒性，越低于限量越安全。: No, the value must be compared with the matching limit; the toxin is cumulatively toxic though, so the further below the limit the safer.
